Each set of three positions $i<j<k$ forms a rotated cycle exactly when the values at those positions have relative order $\pi(j)<\pi(k)<\pi(i)$, which is one of the $3! = 6$ equally likely relative orders.

For a fixed triple of positions, the number of permutations of $\{1,\ldots,10\}$ in which that triple is a rotated cycle is therefore $10!/6$.

There are $\binom{10}{3}=120$ triples of positions, so the total is

$$\binom{10}{3}\cdot\frac{10!}{6} = 120 \cdot 604800 = 72{,}576{,}000.$$

ANSWER: 72576000
